preconditions.description: The number of words N is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= 1000 for li in lengths)
preconditions.description: Each word length li is between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or starts with 'YES\n'.
If the output is not 'NO', it contains N+1 lines.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NO' or all(word in ['0', '1'] * len(word) for word in return_value.split('\n')[1:])
postconditions.description: Each word consists only of the letters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NO' or all(len(word) == li for word, li in zip(return_value.split('\n')[1:], lengths))
postconditions.description: Each word has the length specified in the input.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NO' or all(not any(word.startswith(prefix) for prefix in prefixes) for word, prefixes in zip(return_value.split('\n')[1:], prefixes_list))
postconditions.description: No word is a prefix of another word.
